# Chase Golden Globe

> Chase Golden Globe is a private Australian investment and trade facilitation house, established in 2006 and headquartered in Sydney, New South Wales. The house connects developers, investors, and institutional partners to long-term capital across nine markets worldwide: Australia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Algeria, Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and Luxembourg.

Chase Golden Globe originated in construction and hospitality trade before growing into a broader investment and trade facilitation practice. Its core capabilities include structured project and export finance, capital structuring and risk solutions, impact and sustainable investment, government and institutional liaising, bankability and project readiness advisory, capital raising, mergers and acquisitions, private equity advisory, and joint ventures and strategic alliances. The house serves agriculture and food security, logistics and transport infrastructure, property and hospitality development, renewable energy, industrial manufacturing, and mining and natural resources.
